title: Faint seconds subscript
description: Adds seconds after HH:MM as a small, faint subscript baseline-aligned to sit below the minutes digits, like a quiet precision detail rather than a competing value.

changes.intent: Expose seconds so the template can render them without re-deriving from a Date elsewhere.
changes.detail: Add a `seconds` ref/computed alongside the existing time string, updated on the same ticking interval, via now.value.toLocaleTimeString('es-CR', { second: '2-digit' }) (or slicing the existing formatter output) and returned from the composable.

changes.intent: Render seconds as a trailing subscript inside the clock time element.
changes.detail: Add `{{ seconds }}` immediately after the HH:MM text node inside .screen__clock-time, e.g. `22:40:07`.

changes.intent: Turn the clock-time element into a baseline-aligned flex row so the seconds span can be pinned to the flex-end (subscript) position.
Shrink and mute the seconds relative to HH:MM, dropped to the visual baseline as a subscript.
